answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Work waits on the ferrous until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the jetty of the next round. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The fable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
